gaps.detail: AtomicDirectorySkillPackageSink stages immutable packages, but production sandbox/backend DI must map that trusted staging root to the virtual /skills filesystem used by Deep Agents.

The publication gate validates content-bound evaluation evidence, but the production benchmark service that executes suites and persists signed/durable evidence refs remains a separate composition dependency.

NODE-30 records exact Skill refs syntactically; production promotion should add a cross-registry preflight that proves every referenced Skill exact version exists and is visible before an Agent alias is promoted.
Hosted Actions remains externally blocked if GitHub allocates no runner (runner_id=0, steps=[]). No hosted Ruff/pytest result may be claimed until steps actually execute.
